title: Data and Environment Curation for Post-Training LLMs — Mahesh Sathiamoorthy, Bespoke Labs
talk_summary: A post-training data-curation talk: how Bespoke Labs built reasoning and agent training datasets (Open Thoughts) via LLM-driven question selection, filtering, multi-sample answer generation, and ablations, plus one enterprise fine-tune (Intuit/Credit Karma) that cut latency and improved compliance.

takeaways.what_they_do: They systematically run ablations at each curation stage (question mix, filtering, teacher choice, samples per question) and keep only what moves metrics, rather than guessing.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you run ablations and figure out which, you know, in each of these stages what works and you kind of proceed to the next

takeaways.technique: Stronger model is not always the better teacher
takeaways.what_they_do: They found cheaper/weaker models sometimes produced better training data than stronger ones, so teacher choice was measured, not assumed.
Generating multiple answers per question and filtering beat one answer per many questions, because diversity of reasoning traces helped.
takeaways.evidence_quote: sampling multiple answers per question works pretty well

takeaways.technique: Tag-structured outputs to stop hallucinated specifics
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of plain prompt/response pairs, they added tags so the model focused on form/structure rather than memorizing specific numbers, fixing hallucination of values like 0% APR.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we added these uh tags, which helped the model to focus on, you know, uh uh, the the kind of form rather than the specific numbers itself

takeaways.what_they_do: They use LLMs to optimize prompts/harness system prompts based on reflection over failures.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you can use LLMs itself to uh to to kind of optimize the prompts based on reflection

takeaways.what_they_do: For long-horizon agent rollouts they snapshot and roll back sandbox state so a failed long run doesn't restart from scratch.
takeaways.evidence_quote: at some points you need to do a checkpointing and then you need to be able to snapshot or rollback to something else
